retained_foundations.content: Real and nonarchimedean inverse function and change-of-variables theorems; local Fourier inversion; Haar existence/uniqueness; elementary Radon regularity, partitions of unity, countable product measures, Fubini/Tonelli and monotone/dominated convergence. The actual Gram coarea, pointwise fiber uniqueness, global product and all-section Weil normalization are proved in GMR3--GMR11, not assumed as black boxes.

Finite-dimensional linear algebra, the different as the integral trace-dual lattice, the Chinese remainder theorem and elementary facts about completions and unramified quadratic etale algebras. The adelic character parameter argument, finite-field counts, good-place lifting, exact densities and positivity are reconstructed in the human proofs.

These assert finite arithmetic quotient volume and the smooth compactly supported convergent-range theta/density equality with their original universal choices. Neither is proved here.

The entire original SiegelWeilUnitaryConvergent: every CM extension/nondegenerate Hermitian space; FinVol and SiegelDensities with 2a<n, every nondegenerate rational T, basis and smooth compactly supported rapidly decaying/pure-finite test factorization; all source Haar/fundamental-domain/character/self-dual choices; continuous densities, multipliable local values and equality to the normalized arithmetic theta mean. No new theorem of arithmetic volume or theta means is claimed.
